name: Live Oak Acorn

facts.where: The iconic spreading live oak, statewide

caution: Raw acorns are bitter and hard on the gut from tannins; they must be leached in repeated changes of water until no longer bitter before eating. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Harvesting
sections.body: Live oak acorns are among the least bitter and were a Native staple. Gather sound, unwormed nuts as they drop.

sections.title: Leaching and flour
sections.body: Shell, then soak or boil in many changes of water until the bitterness is gone. Dry and grind the result into a rich, nutty flour.
